narration.text: One tool here gets you a week of content in an hour, completely free.

Coming in at number five is Canva's Magic Studio. This incredible suite of tools designs all your social media posts and videos instantly. It helps your small business look professional without hiring a designer.
Number four, ChatGPT. It drafts email campaigns and ad copy quickly, saving you hours of writing. You can get a solid first draft for any marketing message in minutes.
At number three, Midjourney. This tool creates stunning, unique images for all your campaigns. Imagine bespoke visuals that perfectly match your brand, generated in seconds.
Number two is Zapier. This powerful automation tool connects your apps and automates lead capture and follow-up emails. It handles the busywork so you can focus on selling.
And the top spot goes to Surfer SEO. This tool optimises your content to rank higher on Google, driving more organic traffic to your business. It is a game changer for online visibility.
Surfer SEO is your ultimate weapon for online visibility. So, what AI marketing tool do you think should have made our list?

description: Unlock the power of AI for your small business marketing. This countdown reveals five essential tools that can boost your online presence and generate leads, some for free.
